1.text: The most effective arts and health work happening right now depends on individual relationships, not formal agreements.

2.text: We already have enough good local examples in Australia to justify scaling without running more pilots.

3.text: Community organisations are currently delivering health outcomes they are neither funded nor recognised for.

4.text: The most promising work in this space is happening outside the health system, not within it.

5.text: The portfolio that pays for the intervention is almost never the one that sees the benefit.

12.text: Current measurement frameworks cannot capture the value this work creates.
